selection_criteria_ex_ante: Drafted BLIND: candidates chosen from external chronology knowledge without consulting the index series, its episodes payload, or any IGRM output. Selecting episodes by browsing the index would make the test circular; this list was written before any lookup.
Discrete and dateable: a single event day, not a slow development.
Wire-covered internationally on the day (Reuters/AP/AFP class).

Maps plausibly to exactly ONE channel construct. Candidates that plausibly load on two channels (e.g., a tanker seizure in Hormuz: gulf_energy phrase territory AND shipping construct) were excluded under this criterion, and that exclusion is recorded here.
Falls inside the backfill range (2017-01-01 onward).
Event names never appear in query terms (the tranche-1 rule, unchanged).
The original 21 stay frozen; this tranche is graded separately and reported separately when signed.
excluded_under_criteria: Stena Impero seizure (2019-07-19): dual-construct, gulf_energy phrases vs shipping construct.
Baltimore bridge collapse (2024-03-26): shipping accident without the geopolitical-chokepoint construct.
Modi US state visit (2023-06-22): not a discrete shock; summit coverage loads diffusely.
US 25% tariff announcement (2025-07-30): inside the +/-3-day window of the already-registered 2025-08-06 escalation; one wave, one episode.
2026 candidates: deliberately none. Post-launch events belong to the out-of-sample section below, registered at occurrence, not reconstructed from memory.
_meta.out_of_sample_rule: For episodes occurring AFTER this draft's date: register the event (channel, date, name) within 7 days of occurrence in a dated commit, before the +3-day detection window has been examined; grading is then mechanical. This makes future validation self-expanding and immune to hindsight selection.
